title: Tall whites' two-month trip to a star near Arcturus, so craft must exceed light speed

tellings.quote: And this was in the mid 1960s. This was like in 1965, the late summer. And there was a six-w weekek or two-month period

plain: Tall, pale beings that a man named Charles Hall calls the Tall Whites once left on a six-week or two-month round trip to a star near Arcturus, so their craft must go faster than light. Hall says he spent three years among these beings at a desert range near Indian Springs, Nevada, and he tells Michels the trip happened in the late summer of 1965. He names the beings he dealt with, such as the Teacher, Range Four Harry and the Tour Guide, and reasons that a trip that far in that little time would mean travel beyond light speed.
